exam_name: Oposiciones Guardia Civil — Escala de Cabos y Guardias
exam_price_notes: €0 — no application fee for Guardia Civil convocatoria (as per current practice)

testing_centers.provider: INAP — Instituto Nacional de Administración Pública
Regional Government / Municipal Exam Centers (varies by convocatoria)

id_requirements: Valid Spanish DNI (Documento Nacional de Identidad) or NIE + supporting ID
exam_rules: Pen-and-paper, written multiple-choice (tipo test) and/or practical exercises. No mobile phones, calculators, or study materials. Negative marking: -0.33 per wrong answer (varies by convocatoria). Answer blank = 0 marks.
renewal_options: Funcionarios de carrera have permanent status; no expiry. Continuing education (formación continua) available but not mandatory for retention.

prerequisites.description: Graduado en ESO or equivalent; Spanish nationality; age 18–36; height min. 162cm (men) / 158cm (women); valid driver's licence (B)

retake_policy.notes: One official call (convocatoria) per year per body; no limit on attempts across years until age limit

Spanish Geography, History and Democratic Values
First Aid, Physical Tests (Cooper Test, Swimming, Chin-ups, Sprint)

editorial.meta_description: Prepare for the Oposiciones Guardia Civil Cabos y Guardias exam covering 6 distinct subjects with 100 questions in 90 minutes.
editorial.overview: The Oposiciones Guardia Civil — Escala de Cabos y Guardias certification is certified by Oposiciones Spain for aspiring personnel. Candidates tackle a detailed 90-minute exam consisting of 100 questions. The thorough test evaluates core competencies across 6 domains covering Spanish Constitutional Law, Civil Guard Organic Law, Criminal Law, Road Traffic Law, geography, history, and physical tests.
editorial.who_should_take: Candidates seeking a role as a Cabo or Guardia in the Spanish Civil Guard must take this test. Applicants prepare for the official convocatoria with an application fee of €0 while demonstrating proficiency in law, geography, and physical conditioning.
editorial.preparation_strategy: Review Spanish Constitutional Law and Fundamental Rights alongside the Civil Guard Organic Law and administrative structure carefully. Study criminal offences and road traffic regulations in detail before the test date. Train extensively for the physical tests, including the Cooper test, swimming, chin-ups, and sprint, while maintaining physical readiness for the examination.

domain_guidance.summary: This primary domain covers Articles 1 through 55 of the Spanish Constitution, focusing heavily on fundamental rights, public liberties, and constitutional principles governing the State and its primary democratic institutions.

This domain focuses intensely on the organizational framework, operational guidelines, and legal foundations of the Civil Guard under Ley Orgánica 11/2007 and LOFCS 2/1986 for all prospective officers.

This specific segment examines criminal legislation addressing specific offences against persons, property, and public order as clearly outlined in the official Código Penal provisions established for law enforcement candidates.
study_focus: Offences against property and public order

domain_guidance.summary: This area pertains directly to road safety regulations, traffic legislation, and the general circulation rules governing vehicle and pedestrian movement across public roadways as mandated by national transit laws.

This subject focuses completely on the national territory, historical milestones, and democratic values of Spain as a vital component of the general knowledge requirements mandated for all candidates taking the test.

This specific module evaluates medical response techniques and athletic performance through detailed physical assessments including sprinting, swimming, chin-ups, and the Cooper test to ensure optimal candidate fitness levels for the corps.
study_focus: Cooper test, swimming, chin-ups, and sprint

editorial.exam_day_guidance: Arrive prepared to complete 100 questions within the 90 minutes allowed. Manage your time effectively across all subjects to secure a passing score of 5.

faq.question_title: How many questions are on the exam?
faq.answer_text: The official test contains exactly 100 questions drawn across 6 weighted domains covering constitutional law, criminal law, traffic law, geography, and physical tests for candidates.
Candidates must achieve a minimum passing score of 5 in order to successfully complete the 90-minute examination administered by Oposiciones Spain during the convocatoria process.
The official exam duration is strictly set to 90 minutes, during which candidates must answer all 100 questions within the specified time limit for the test.

faq.question_title: Is there an application fee for the exam?
faq.answer_text: There is no application fee for the Guardia Civil convocatoria, listed as €0 under current practice. Check with Oposiciones Spain for further details on the certification path.
